Canonical manifests, SHA-256 artifact identity, bounded exact-body admission, dependency-ordered load plans, save plans, complete write/move/delete transition accounting, two-sided compare-and-swap, strict prefab codecs, validation, variants, and resolution are successor-owned without ProjectBundle, runtime bridges, session topology, or replay proof formats.

Sparse assets, semantic material palettes, independent voxel/content hashes, provenance, strict codecs, bounded validation, and fail-atomic palette replacement live with voxel asset behavior; ProjectBundle and runtime-facade request DTOs are excluded.

Annotation regions, kinds, selections, provenance, target identities, queries, typed edits, export, strict codecs, hashes, and diagnostics live with their direct content owner instead of a protocol border.

Strict Studio-usable import, source metadata, plan, preview, apply, texture palette, and bounded model-query shapes live beside their behavior; evidence kinds, runtime dispatch DTOs, session/replay hashes, and replay mismatch vocabulary are excluded.

Typed entries, cursors, bounded diffs, preview/apply revert, undo/redo, redo-tail invalidation, hashes, quotas, and durable reconstruction stay with voxel authority; protocol routing, replay proof, and checkpoint catalog DTOs are excluded.
Strict bounded validation, canonical SHA-256 identities, region queries, atomic typed edits, and compare-and-swap export are successor-owned without runtime-layer indirection.
The existing successor sparse asset codec now also preserves semantic palette bindings and independent voxel-data identity with stricter SHA-256 validation.

The existing sampled surface and closed-solid converter now has SHA-256 plans, bounded previews, guarded apply, contain/cover/stretch fit, three origin policies, affine transforms, direct/default/texture material resolution, stale-source rejection, and deterministic model readouts without runtime facades or replay proof.

Prepared preview/commit edits, atomic multi-cell authority rebuild, renderer-hint and transformed-instance picking, bounded undo/redo/revert history, diffs, stale-hash rejection, and strict reconstruction codecs are direct spatial service behavior; replay logs, ProjectBundle compaction, proof hashes, and old generated-chunk topology are excluded.

Deterministic bounded tunnel cells, material roles, spawn markers, centered frame, collision AABBs, SHA-256 provenance, and direct spatial projection admission remain; replay events, proof fixtures, and renderer-specific chunk records are replaced by native owner APIs.

GLB-only static mesh parsing, canonical SHA-256 source identity, group/material/bounds metadata, strict request decoding, and cumulative 64 MiB/2M-vertex/6M-index guardrails remain inside the offline conversion owner; filesystem, renderer, runtime bridge, animation, and skin behavior remain excluded.

Fixed tick steps, acceleration, gravity scaling, zero-step behavior, finite validation, fail-closed query requirements, and actual voxel collision resolution are direct spatial mechanics without a runtime service facade.

Registered typed definitions, world-transform AABBs, enter/continued/exit reconciliation, activation/lifecycle cleanup, bounded readouts, and strict snapshot restore remain beside entity-state and collision; owner routing and replay hashes are removed.
M11R preserves controller graphs, parameters, blends, transition timing, and deterministic sampling while removing replay authority.

Strict bounded offline mesh sources produce native render-model and asset-catalog artifacts with SHA-256 manifests, stable sidecar GUIDs and typed settings, drift and reimport classification, dry-run plans, and verified whole-directory publication; runtime import, Asha fixture generation, evidence dumps, and per-file partial publication are excluded.
Narrow stored catalog, reference, material, lock, and diagnostic shapes live with their behavior instead of a protocol umbrella.

Narrow stored DTOs and typed service inputs live with entity-state; global routing vocabularies, universal proposal commands, ProjectBundle traces, and game-domain health, weapon, policy, spawn, and faction declarations are deliberately not generic engine state.

ProjectBundle composition, session equivalence, save/load proof, source tracing, and duplicate renderer resource authority are removed.

Typed preview, apply, readout, cycle checks, provenance, rerooting, and projection-only refusal live beside their one authoritative relationship graph rather than behind a rule facade.
